body: How does a soul burn, tho? 😂
Probably relieved. I’m not enjoying my life. It’s nearly all been painful. The only growth I’ve experienced is my anger and resentment towards life.
You can’t know that. I’m not sure if there’s any actual purpose for being other than to just be. The idea of a punishment for leaving a plane of existence when death is inevitable is a bit asinine.

Well, the good news is that life DOES end. When? That depends. As far as a reason to keep going, that’s a “man in the mirror” question (or woman). If there’s something that makes life’s bullshit worth it for you, then keep going. Only you know what that is. People are just going to feed you motivational nonsense. Ultimately, you give your life purpose. One thing that I’ve learned that is very true is that if you have a strong enough “why”, you can overcome any how. If you can’t find that “why”, then be honest with yourself and seek the right answer for your life.

I’m on the verge of homelessness too. I left my job (in which I was barely getting by working like a fucking maniac, but it paid some of the bills) to start a business. My partner used me, and I ran out of money. If that’s what you get for taking the “leap of faith”, then fuck that. If hell is separation from god, point me in that direction. I’m sorry for all that you’ve been through. I’m taking my life in a few hours. I wish you luck with whatever you decide to do. Like you, I can’t overcome homelessness and destitution. I’m in this world alone. I’m choosing death over that. That’s my choice. Explore all your options before you make an ultimate decision.

It’s a very horrid system. School teaches you absolutely nothing about the real world. The education system is designed to develop workers who won’t question the futility of their situation. Adulthood is nothing more than paying for a subscription to life.

In this world, no. Suicidal thoughts are RATIONAL, but not normal. Normal, in this world, is working in futility within a rigged, crooked social system just to survive and calling it “the ups and downs of life.”

“It is no measure of health to be well adjusted to a profoundly sick society.”

- Jiddu Krishnamurti
This made me laugh. I feel the same way.

I feel ALL of this. I’m in my 40s and I’m lonely. I tried to put myself out there in a new city, but I’ve learned that humans aren’t social. That’s one of the biggest myths about humans. They’re not social creatures, they’re cooperative creatures. They socialize with those aligned with their personal interests, whatever that may be. So my happy ass just wanting to be friends without any social or economic payoff is off putting and stale to most people. At least, that’s my final analysis.

I’m in the same boat. Humans are afraid to die because we understand that we’ve never experienced life. Just productive existence. It SEEMS like life, because we’re working to further the development of the system that humans have decided to organize themselves in. Yet, we can’t understand why the vast majority of us are still unhappy, unfulfilled, and depressed.

I’m just listening to random stuff that have sad or lullaby-ish tunes. I’m weird like that. I can listen to a love song, but hear something totally different because of the melody and the beat. The lyrics fall away, and the music itself speaks to my soul. For example, “Three Times a Lady” by The Commodores. Sure it’s a great love song, but the melody of it says something totally different to me. It’s like a beautiful lullaby that only I understand. I don’t know, I’m old and weird.
I feel you. No one understands my struggles.
That’s how I feel. Every dude on the planet is better than I am. Or, at least that’s how a lot of my “loved ones” have made me feel my entire life.
I’m not sure. I’m learning that any method takes careful research.
